name: Particle-based Volume Rendering (PBVR)
aliases: Particle Density Estimation for Particle-Based Volume Rendering (PBVR)
Particle-based Volume Rendering with Density Estimation
Stochastic approach for previewing large irregular volume datasets
definition: A method to generate images uniquely corresponding to a transfer function for large-scale unstructured volume data by estimating particle density from a particle emission model and generating particles per tetrahedral cell.
